anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Old Rectory Hotel & Spa: Tranquil Coastal Luxury Steps from Hobie Beach
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Experience serene luxury at The Old Rectory Hotel & Spa, a beautifully restored sanctuary just moments from Plettenberg Bay's pristine Hobie Beach. Our boutique hotel blends historic charm with modern comfort, offering elegantly appointed rooms, a tranquil outdoor pool, and a sophisticated bar and lounge. Indulge in personalized service from our local insider team, who ensure every stay is tailored to your desires. Discover authentic local dining and vibrant coastal life within a short stroll, making us the perfect base for exploring the Garden Route. Unwind in an atmosphere of relaxed sophistication, where every detail is crafted for your ultimate comfort and a truly memorable Plettenberg Bay escape.
